newsitem.title: UK: Tate & Lyle falls as UBS cuts forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Tate & Lyle falls as UBS cuts forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Tate & Lyle Plc fell on Friday as analysts at UBS shaved profit forecasts for the food manufacturer.
The shares were 16-1/2p lower at 468-1/2p by 1156 GMT in trade of 1.5 million shares.

Market sources said UBS analyst Charlie Mills had slightly reduced his profit forecasts which were already at the bottom of the range of expectations. Sources said he had not changed his stance on the shares.
Mills was unavailable for immediate comment. --Elaine Hardcastle, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
